title: 第27章
content:
楚皓盘膝坐在床上，细细体悟着体内奔腾不息的元力。淬体境五重巅峰！这股力量，比之先前，何止强了十倍！混沌圣体初显神威，每一个细胞都充满了爆炸性的力量感，而《吞天魔功》的霸道更是让他心惊，那鲸吞天地般的吸力，仿佛能将世间一切能量化为己用。“青阳大比魁首……”楚皓嘴角勾起一抹自信的弧度，三个月，如今看来，并非遥不可及。他甚至有些期待，当萧清雪看到自己真正实力时，会是怎样一副精彩的表情。就在他沉浸在新力量带来的畅快中时，“砰砰砰！”急促而粗暴的敲门声猛地响起，打断了他的思绪。“少爷！少爷不好了！”门外传来一个楚家下人带着哭腔的尖叫，声音抖得不成样子，“林……林家家主林啸天，带着一大群人打上门了！指名道姓要您……要您出去给个说法！”楚皓眉梢一挑，眼中寒光一闪即逝。林家？他正愁这身力量没处使呢，这就有人主动送上门来了。“来得正好，省得我再跑一趟。”他起身，掸了掸衣袍上并不存在的灰尘，语气平淡得仿佛只是要去赴一场普通的约会。此刻的楚家大院，早已乱成了一锅粥。林啸天，一个身材魁梧，面容阴鸷的中年男人，正背着手，一脸煞气地站在院子中央。他身后，黑压压地站着十几个手持棍棒、腰挎短刀的林家打手，一个个凶神恶煞，将整个院子都衬得杀气腾腾。林云则被人用一张软榻抬着，他脸色惨白，右臂被布条草草包裹，吊在胸前，眼神怨毒得像是要噬人的毒蛇，死死盯着楚皓房间的方向。楚山河，楚皓的父亲，正搓着手，满脸焦急和惶恐地挡在林啸天身前，声音带着哀求：“林家主，林家主息怒啊！小儿无状，冲撞了贵公子，我……我代他给您赔罪，您要打要骂，冲我来，冲我来就好！”“滚开！”林啸天根本不看他，手臂随意一挥，一股劲风便将楚山河推得踉跄后退，一屁股跌坐在地上，狼狈不堪。“爹！”楚皓刚走出月洞门，便看到这一幕，眼神骤然一冷。周围的楚家下人们更是吓得噤若寒蝉，一个个缩在角落里，连大气都不敢喘一口，生怕殃及池鱼。“林家主，好大的威风啊。”楚皓缓步走出，目光平静地扫过院内剑拔弩张的众人，最后落在林啸天身上，语气听不出喜怒，“带着这么多人来我楚家，是打算拆了我这小门小户，还是想在我楚家吃顿便饭？”他这话一出，几个年轻的林家打手差点没忍住笑出声，但看到林啸天那要杀人的眼神，又赶紧憋了回去。林啸天双目赤红，死死盯着楚皓，那眼神像是要将他生吞活剥：“楚皓小儿！你这废物东西，竟敢下如此毒手，废了我儿林云！今日，你若不给我一个满意的交代，我便踏平你楚家，让你楚家上下鸡犬不留！”他声音洪亮，蕴含着淬体境九重武者的元力，震得人耳膜嗡嗡作响。林云躺在软榻上，听到父亲的话，眼中闪过一丝快意，仿佛已经看到楚皓跪地求饶的凄惨模样。他咬牙切齿地嘶声道：“爹！给我废了他！我要让他求生不得，求死不能！”楚皓闻言，却是嗤笑一声，摇了摇头，看向林云的眼神带着一丝怜悯：“啧啧，手下败将，还敢狺狺狂吠？你儿子技不如人，主动上门挑衅，挨打也是活该。怎么，小的打不过，老的就要出来找场子？至于交代……”他顿了顿，嘴角那抹弧度骤然变得冰冷，“可以，想要交代，就看你们林家有没有这个本事来拿了！或者，拿你们的命来换！”“狂妄至极！”林啸天勃然大怒，他横行青阳城多年，何曾被一个小辈如此顶撞？“好个不知死活的小畜生！给我上！先打断他的四肢，我看他还怎么嚣张！”一声令下，那十几个林家打手如狼似虎般怒吼着扑了上来，手中的棍棒带起呼呼风声，直往楚皓身上招呼。楚山河吓得魂飞魄散，尖叫道：“皓儿，快跑！”然而，楚皓却站在原地，不闪不避，嘴角甚至还带着一丝若有若无的笑意。就在那些棍棒即将落到他身上的刹那，楚皓动了！他的身形快如鬼魅，仿佛一道青烟，瞬间从原地消失。“砰！”一个冲在最前面的林家打手只觉得眼前一花，胸口便传来一股无法抗拒的巨力，整个人如同断了线的风筝般倒飞出去，口中鲜血狂喷，撞在院墙上发出一声闷响，滑落在地，生死不知。楚皓的身影再次出现，已经突入人群之中。混沌圣体带来的恐怖肉身力量在这一刻展露无遗！他甚至没有动用多少元力，仅仅是凭借肉身的强度和速度，便在人群中掀起了一片腥风血雨。“咔嚓！”又一个打手的手臂被他随手一折，发出令人牙酸的骨裂声，惨叫着倒地。楚皓的动作干净利落，没有丝毫拖泥带水。他时而一拳轰出，空气中发出一声沉闷的爆响，中者胸骨塌陷；时而一脚踢出，快如闪电，被踢中的打手往往还在半空，便已昏死过去。那些林家打手平日里在青阳城也算得上是好勇斗狠之辈，但在淬体境五重巅峰，并且拥有混沌圣体的楚皓面前，简直如同土鸡瓦狗，不堪一击！惨叫声、骨裂声、重物坠地声，此起彼伏。短短不过十几个呼吸的功夫，方才还气势汹汹的十几个林家打手，此刻已经横七竖八地躺了一地，一个个鼻青脸肿，断手断脚，哀嚎不止，再也爬不起来。

整个楚家大院，除了这些人的呻吟，一时间竟落针可闻。楚皓负手而立，站在那群哀嚎的打手中央，衣衫整洁，甚至连呼吸都没有丝毫紊乱，仿佛只是做了一件微不足道的小事。这一幕，彻底震慑了在场的所有人。楚山河张大了嘴巴，呆呆地看着自己的儿子，大脑一片空白。这……这还是他那个不成器的废物儿子吗？那些原本瑟瑟发抖的楚家下人，此刻看向楚皓的眼神，已经从最初的担忧，变成了深深的敬畏与狂热。而林啸天，这位林家家主，此刻脸上的表情更是精彩至极。他脸上的肌肉在不受控制地抽搐，双眼瞪得如同铜铃，死死地盯着楚皓，那眼神中充满了骇然与不可置信。怎么可能？！这些打手虽然不是林家的顶尖战力，但个个也都有淬体境四五重的修为，联手之下，就算是淬体境七八重的高手也得暂避锋芒。可楚皓这个小畜生，这个传闻中连淬体境四重都未突破的废物，竟然……竟然如此轻描淡写地就将他们全部解决了？而且看他的样子，似乎还游刃有余！这还是那个被他儿子打得毫无还手之力的楚皓吗？他身旁的林云，更是吓得面无人色，嘴唇哆嗦着，连一句完整的话都说不出来，看向楚皓的眼神，只剩下无边的恐惧。他终于明白，那日在大厅，楚皓废掉他，根本就不是侥幸！楚皓没有理会那些躺在地上哀嚎的喽啰，他缓缓抬起眼皮，目光如同两道利剑，直刺林啸天：“现在，该你了。”他一步一步，不疾不徐地朝着林啸天走去。每一步踏出，都仿佛踩在林啸天的心脏上，让他感到一股莫名的压力。林啸天喉结滚动了一下，下意识地后退了半步，但旋即反应过来，自己堂堂林家家主，淬体境九重的高手，岂能被一个小辈吓住？他强自镇定，色厉内荏地喝道：“楚皓！你……你别太嚣张！我乃林家家主，你若敢动我一根汗毛，我林家与你楚家不死不休！整个青阳城，也将没有你的立足之地！”“哦？是吗？”楚皓嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度，眼中闪过一丝戏谑，“我倒要看看，你怎么让我没有立足之地。”话音未落，楚皓丹田内的《吞天魔功》悄然运转。一股无形而霸道的吸力，猛地从他掌心散发出来，瞬间笼罩向林啸天！林啸天只觉得周身空气一紧，随即一股难以言喻的恐慌感从心底升起。他骇然发现，自己体内辛辛苦苦修炼而来的元力，竟然像是找到了宣泄口一般，不受控制地开始向外流逝！而那股吸力的源头，正是眼前的楚皓！“这……这是什么妖法？！”林啸天脸色骤变，眼中充满了惊骇与不解，他能清晰感觉到自己的力量正在被对方诡异地抽取！这种感觉，他从未体验过，也从未听说过！他拼命地想要抵抗，想要稳固体内的元力，但那股吸力却越来越强，如同一个无底的漩涡，要将他彻底吞噬！“我的元力……我的元力在流失！”林啸天惊恐地叫出声，声音中带着一丝颤抖。短短片刻，他便感觉自己体内的元力至少流失了一成！照这个速度下去，用不了多久，他就会被吸成人干！恐惧，如同潮水般将他淹没。他看着楚皓那张带着淡淡笑意的年轻脸庞，却仿佛看到了世间最可怕的恶魔。“魔……魔功！你练的是魔功！”林啸天像是想到了什么极为恐怖的事情，失声尖叫起来，声音中充满了绝望与难以置信。林啸天脸色唰地一下变得惨白，声音因极度的恐惧而尖锐扭曲，“楚皓！你……你竟敢修炼此等魔功！”他想挣扎，想后退，但那股吸力如同跗骨之蛆，死死地将他锁定。他能清晰地感觉到，自己的力量，自己的生机，正在被眼前的少年疯狂抽取！楚皓嘴角噙着一抹冰冷的笑意，眼神幽深得如同万年寒潭：“成王败寇，弱肉强食，本就是这世间的至理。林家主，死到临头，就别这么多废话了。”话音未落，他丹田内的《吞天魔功》骤然加速运转，掌心的吸力陡然增强数倍！“啊——！”林啸天发出一声凄厉至极的惨嚎，他那魁梧的身躯以肉眼可见的速度干瘪下去，皮肤迅速失去光泽，变得如同老树皮一般枯槁。他眼中充满了无尽的悔恨与绝望，他想不明白，为何短短几日，这个曾经被他视为蝼蚁的废物，会变成如此可怕的恶魔！他淬体境九重的浑厚元力，在《吞天魔功》面前，竟没有丝毫反抗之力，源源不断地被楚皓吸入体内，化作最精纯的能量。不……不要……皓……楚少侠，饶命……我林家……林家愿奉上所有……”林啸天的声音越来越微弱，充满了哀求，但楚皓神色没有丝毫波动。此刻的楚家大院，静得可怕。楚山河瘫坐在不远处，双手死死地抠着地面，指甲缝里渗出血丝。他看着自己的儿子，看着那诡异而霸道的吞噬场面，心脏像是被一只无形的大手紧紧攥住，几乎要窒息。这真的是他的皓儿吗？这种功法，太过邪异，太过恐怖，闻所未闻！他心中既有一丝儿子变强的欣慰，更多的却是对未来的深深忧虑和恐惧。那些楚家下人，早已吓得魂不附体，一个个面如土色，蜷缩在角落里，连呼吸都刻意放缓，生怕引起那个如魔神般少年的注意。看向楚皓的眼神，充满了极致的敬畏与恐惧。
content_en:
Chu Hao sat cross-legged on the bed, carefully comprehending the endless energy in his body.The fifth level peak of the body tempering realm!This power is more than ten times stronger than before!The Chaos Holy Body first showed its power, and every cell was filled with an explosive sense of power. The domineering power of the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" frightened him even more. The suction force like a whale swallowing the world seemed to be able to use all the energy in the world for its own use."The leader of the Qingyang Competition..." Chu Hao's lips curved with a hint of confidence. Three months, now it seems, is not out of reach.He even looked forward to what kind of wonderful expression Xiao Qingxue would have when she saw her true strength.Just when he was immersed in the pleasure brought by his new power, "Bang, bang, bang!" A rapid and rough knock on the door suddenly sounded, interrupting his thoughts."Master! The master is not good!" A servant of the Chu family screamed with tears outside the door, his voice trembling. "Lin... Lin Xiaotian, the head of the Lin family, came to the door with a large group of people! He asked you by name... He asked you to go out and give an explanation!" Chu Hao raised his eyebrows, and the cold light in his eyes flashed away.Lin family?He was worried that there was nothing he could do with his strength, when someone took the initiative to send it to his door."It's just in time, it saves me another trip." He stood up, dusted off the non-existent dust on his robe, and spoke in a calm tone, as if he was just going on an ordinary date.At this moment, the Chu family compound had already turned into a mess.Lin Xiaotian, a middle-aged man with a burly build and a sinister face, was standing in the middle of the yard with his hands behind his back and an evil look on his face.Behind him, standing in darkness were a dozen Lin family thugs armed with sticks and daggers at their waists. Each one of them looked fierce, giving the whole yard a murderous look.Lin Yun was carried on a soft couch. His face was pale, his right arm was hastily wrapped in a strip of cloth and hung in front of his chest. His eyes were as vicious as a poisonous snake that wanted to bite people, staring in the direction of Chu Hao's room.Chu Shanhe, Chu Hao's father, was rubbing his hands, standing in front of Lin Xiaotian with a face full of anxiety and fear, and pleading in his voice: "Master Lin, please calm down, Master Lin! I, my son, are in a stateless state, and I bumped into your young master. I...I will give it to you on his behalf."Apologize, if you want to be beaten or scolded, just come to me, come to me!" "Get away!" Lin Xiaotian didn't look at him at all. With a random wave of his arm, a strong wind pushed Chu Shanhe back, and he fell to the ground in a miserable state."Dad!" As soon as Chu Hao walked out of the moon cave door, he saw this scene and his eyes suddenly turned cold.The surrounding servants of the Chu family were even more frightened into silence. They huddled in the corner one by one, not even daring to take a breath for fear of harming Chi Yu."Master Lin, you are so majestic." Chu Hao walked out slowly, his eyes calmly swept across the tense people in the courtyard, and finally fell on Lin Xiaotian. His tone could not detect any emotion or anger, "Bringing so many people to my Chu family is not a good idea.Even if you want to tear down my small family, do you still want to have a casual meal at my Chu family?" As soon as he said this, several young Lin family thugs almost couldn't hold back their laughter, but they quickly suppressed it when they saw the murderous look in Lin Xiaotian's eyes.Lin Xiaotian's eyes were red and he was staring at Chu Hao with eyes that seemed to devour him alive: "Child Chu Hao! How dare you do such a cruel thing to kill my son Lin Yun! If you don't give me a satisfactory explanation today, I will crush your Chu family and leave no one behind!" His loud voice contained the energy of a ninth-level warrior in the Body Tempering Realm, which made people's eardrums buzz.Lin Yun was lying on the soft couch. Hearing his father's words, a trace of joy flashed in his eyes, as if he had seen the miserable look of Chu Hao kneeling down begging for mercy.He gritted his teeth and hissed: "Father! Kill him for me! I want him to be unable to live or die!" Chu Hao sneered when he heard this, shook his head, and looked at Lin Yun with a trace of pity in his eyes: "Tsk, tsk, you are defeated, and you still dare to bark? Your son is not as skilled as others, and he takes the initiative to come to provoke him, so he deserves to be beaten. Why, I can't beat him."But the old man is going to come out to find trouble?As for the explanation..." He paused, and the curve of his mouth suddenly turned cold, "Okay, if you want to explain, it depends on whether you, the Lin family, have the ability to take it!Or, it will cost you your life!" Lin Xiaotian was furious. He had been running rampant in Qingyang City for many years, and he had never been so contradicted by a junior?"What a desperate little beast! Come on! Break his limbs first, and let me see how arrogant he can be!" With the order, the dozen Lin family thugs roared like wolves and tigers and rushed forward. The sticks in their hands made a whirling sound and went straight to greet Chu Hao.Chu Shanhe was so frightened that he screamed: "Hao'er, run!" However, Chu Hao stood on the spot, not evading, and even had a faint smile on his lips.Just when those sticks were about to fall on him, Chu Hao moved!His figure was as fast as a ghost, disappearing from the place in an instant like a wisp of blue smoke."Bang!" A Lin family thug who rushed at the front felt his eyes blurred, and an irresistible force came from his chest. He flew upside down like a kite with a broken string, blood spurted from his mouth, and hit the courtyard wall with a muffled sound. He fell to the ground, not knowing whether he was alive or dead.Chu Hao's figure appeared again and had already broken into the crowd.The terrifying physical power brought by the Chaos Holy Body is fully revealed at this moment!He didn't even use much Yuan Power, just relying on the strength and speed of his physical body, he caused a bloody storm among the crowd."Crack!" Another thug's arm was casually folded by him, making a heart-breaking sound of bone cracking, and he screamed and fell to the ground.Chu Hao's movements were clean and neat, without any sloppiness.Sometimes he punches out, causing a dull explosion in the air, and the victim's sternum collapses; sometimes he kicks out, as fast as lightning, and the thug who is kicked often faints while still mid-air.Those Lin family thugs are usually considered brave and fierce in Qingyang City, but in front of Chu Hao, who is at the fifth level of the Body Tempering Realm and possesses the Chaos Holy Body, they are like chickens and dogs, vulnerable to a single blow!Screams, bones cracking, and heavy objects falling to the ground came and went.In just a dozen breaths, the dozen or so Lin family thugs who had been so aggressive just now were lying on the ground in a mess, with bruised noses and swollen faces, broken arms and legs, wailing incessantly, and unable to get up anymore.

In the entire Chu family compound, apart from the moans of these people, one could hear a needle drop for a while.Chu Hao stood with his hands behind his back, standing in the middle of the group of wailing thugs. His clothes were neat and his breathing was not disturbed at all, as if he had just done a trivial thing.This scene completely shocked everyone present.Chu Shanhe opened his mouth wide and stared at his son blankly, his mind going blank.This...is this still his incompetent good-for-nothing son?The servants of the Chu family who were originally trembling now looked at Chu Hao from initial concern to deep awe and enthusiasm.And Lin Xiaotian, the head of the Lin family, had an even more wonderful expression on his face at this moment.The muscles on his face were twitching uncontrollably, and his eyes were as wide as copper bells, staring at Chu Hao, his eyes full of shock and disbelief.How is it possible?!Although these thugs are not the top combat power of the Lin family, they all have cultivation levels of the fourth and fifth levels of the Body Tempering Realm. Together, even the masters of the seventh and eighth levels of the Body Tempering Realm have to temporarily avoid the edge.But Chu Hao, this little beast, this trash who was rumored to have not even broken through to the fourth level of the Body Tempering Realm, actually... actually solved them all in such an understatement?And judging by his appearance, he seems to be doing it with ease!Is this still the Chu Hao who was beaten by his son until he was unable to fight back?Lin Yun next to him was so frightened that his face turned pale, his lips were trembling, and he couldn't even say a complete sentence. He looked at Chu Hao with only boundless fear in his eyes.He finally understood that Chu Hao's defeat of him that day in the hall was not a fluke at all!Chu Hao ignored the wailing minions lying on the ground. He slowly raised his eyelids, his eyes like two sharp swords, piercing Lin Xiaotian: "Now, it's your turn." He walked towards Lin Xiaotian step by step, unhurriedly.Every step he took seemed to step on Lin Xiaotian's heart, making him feel an inexplicable pressure.Lin Xiaotian's Adam's apple rolled, and he subconsciously took half a step back, but he immediately realized that he was the majestic head of the Lin family, a master of the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm, how could he be intimidated by a junior?He forced himself to calm down and shouted in a stern voice: "Chu Hao! You... don't be too arrogant! I am the head of the Lin family. If you dare to touch a hair on my head, my Lin family and your Chu family will fight to the death! There will be no place for you in the entire Qingyang City!"Oh? Really?"The corner of Chu Hao's mouth curled up with a hint of teasing, "I want to see how you can make me lose my footing."Before he finished speaking, Chu Hao's "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" was quietly operating.An invisible and overbearing suction force suddenly emanated from his palm and enveloped Lin Xiaotian in an instant!Lin Xiaotian only felt the air around him tighten, and then an indescribable sense of panic rose from the bottom of his heart.He was shocked to find that the Yuan Power that he had worked so hard to cultivate in his body began to flow out uncontrollably, as if it had found an outlet!And the source of that suction was none other than Chu Hao in front of him!"This... what kind of magic is this?!" Lin Xiaotian's face suddenly changed, and his eyes were full of horror and confusion. He could clearly feel that his power was being strangely extracted by the other party!He has never experienced this feeling, and has never heard of it!He tried desperately to resist and stabilize the energy in his body, but the suction force became stronger and stronger, like a bottomless whirlpool, trying to swallow him completely!"My Yuan Power... My Yuan Power is losing!" Lin Xiaotian cried out in horror, with a hint of trembling in his voice.In just a few moments, he felt that at least 10% of the energy in his body had been lost!If he continues at this rate, it won't be long before he's sucked and fucked!Fear overwhelmed him like a tide.He looked at Chu Hao's young face with a faint smile, but he seemed to see the most terrifying demon in the world."Demon...Demon Kung Fu! What you practice is Demon Kung Fu!" Lin Xiaotian seemed to have thought of something extremely terrifying and screamed, his voice full of despair and disbelief.Lin Xiaotian's face suddenly turned pale, and his voice was sharp and distorted due to extreme fear, "Chu Hao! You... how dare you practice such magic!" He wanted to struggle and retreat, but the suction force was like a tarsal maggot, locking him tightly.He could clearly feel that his strength and vitality were being wildly extracted by the young man in front of him!There was a cold smile on Chu Hao's lips, and his eyes were as deep as a thousand-year-old cold pond: "The winner is the king, the enemy is the enemy, the weak is the strongest, this is the principle of this world. Master Lin, when you are about to die, stop talking so much nonsense." Before he finished speaking, the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" in his Dantian suddenly accelerated, and the suction force in his palm suddenly increased several times!"Ah——!" Lin Xiaotian let out a shrill howl. His burly body shriveled up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and his skin quickly lost its luster and became as withered as old tree bark.His eyes were filled with endless regret and despair. He couldn't understand why, in just a few days, this waste that he once regarded as an ant had turned into such a terrifying demon!His profound energy at the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm showed no resistance in the face of the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique". It was continuously sucked into Chu Hao's body and turned into the purest energy.No... don't... Hao... Young Master Chu, spare your life... I, the Lin family... The Lin family is willing to give everything..." Lin Xiaotian's voice became weaker and weaker, full of pleading, but Chu Hao's expression did not waver at all. At this moment, the Chu family compound was quiet.It was terrifying.Chu Shanhe sat slumped not far away, clawing at the ground with his hands, blood oozing from his fingernails.He looked at his son, watching the strange and overbearing devouring scene, and his heart seemed to be tightly grasped by an invisible hand., almost suffocating.Is this really his Hao'er?This kind of technique is too strange, too terrifying, and unheard of!He feels a little relieved that his son has become stronger, but more of a deep worry and fear about the future.The servants were so frightened that they huddled in the corner with earth-colored faces, deliberately slowing down their breathing, for fear of attracting the attention of the demon-like young man.Their eyes were full of awe and fear when they looked at Chu Hao.

楚皓盘膝坐在床上，细细体悟着体内奔腾不息的元力。淬体境五重巅峰！这股力量，比之先前，何止强了十倍！混沌圣体初显神威，每一个细胞都充满了爆炸性的力量感，而《吞天魔功》的霸道更是让他心惊，那鲸吞天地般的吸力，仿佛能将世间一切能量化为己用。“青阳大比魁首……”楚皓嘴角勾起一抹自信的弧度，三个月，如今看来，并非遥不可及。他甚至有些期待，当萧清雪看到自己真正实力时，会是怎样一副精彩的表情。就在他沉浸在新力量带来的畅快中时，“砰砰砰！”急促而粗暴的敲门声猛地响起，打断了他的思绪。“少爷！少爷不好了！”门外传来一个楚家下人带着哭腔的尖叫，声音抖得不成样子，“林……林家家主林啸天，带着一大群人打上门了！指名道姓要您……要您出去给个说法！”楚皓眉梢一挑，眼中寒光一闪即逝。林家？他正愁这身力量没处使呢，这就有人主动送上门来了。“来得正好，省得我再跑一趟。”他起身，掸了掸衣袍上并不存在的灰尘，语气平淡得仿佛只是要去赴一场普通的约会。此刻的楚家大院，早已乱成了一锅粥。林啸天，一个身材魁梧，面容阴鸷的中年男人，正背着手，一脸煞气地站在院子中央。他身后，黑压压地站着十几个手持棍棒、腰挎短刀的林家打手，一个个凶神恶煞，将整个院子都衬得杀气腾腾。林云则被人用一张软榻抬着，他脸色惨白，右臂被布条草草包裹，吊在胸前，眼神怨毒得像是要噬人的毒蛇，死死盯着楚皓房间的方向。楚山河，楚皓的父亲，正搓着手，满脸焦急和惶恐地挡在林啸天身前，声音带着哀求：“林家主，林家主息怒啊！小儿无状，冲撞了贵公子，我……我代他给您赔罪，您要打要骂，冲我来，冲我来就好！”“滚开！”林啸天根本不看他，手臂随意一挥，一股劲风便将楚山河推得踉跄后退，一屁股跌坐在地上，狼狈不堪。“爹！”楚皓刚走出月洞门，便看到这一幕，眼神骤然一冷。周围的楚家下人们更是吓得噤若寒蝉，一个个缩在角落里，连大气都不敢喘一口，生怕殃及池鱼。“林家主，好大的威风啊。”楚皓缓步走出，目光平静地扫过院内剑拔弩张的众人，最后落在林啸天身上，语气听不出喜怒，“带着这么多人来我楚家，是打算拆了我这小门小户，还是想在我楚家吃顿便饭？”他这话一出，几个年轻的林家打手差点没忍住笑出声，但看到林啸天那要杀人的眼神，又赶紧憋了回去。林啸天双目赤红，死死盯着楚皓，那眼神像是要将他生吞活剥：“楚皓小儿！你这废物东西，竟敢下如此毒手，废了我儿林云！今日，你若不给我一个满意的交代，我便踏平你楚家，让你楚家上下鸡犬不留！”他声音洪亮，蕴含着淬体境九重武者的元力，震得人耳膜嗡嗡作响。林云躺在软榻上，听到父亲的话，眼中闪过一丝快意，仿佛已经看到楚皓跪地求饶的凄惨模样。他咬牙切齿地嘶声道：“爹！给我废了他！我要让他求生不得，求死不能！”楚皓闻言，却是嗤笑一声，摇了摇头，看向林云的眼神带着一丝怜悯：“啧啧，手下败将，还敢狺狺狂吠？你儿子技不如人，主动上门挑衅，挨打也是活该。怎么，小的打不过，老的就要出来找场子？至于交代……”他顿了顿，嘴角那抹弧度骤然变得冰冷，“可以，想要交代，就看你们林家有没有这个本事来拿了！或者，拿你们的命来换！”“狂妄至极！”林啸天勃然大怒，他横行青阳城多年，何曾被一个小辈如此顶撞？“好个不知死活的小畜生！给我上！先打断他的四肢，我看他还怎么嚣张！”一声令下，那十几个林家打手如狼似虎般怒吼着扑了上来，手中的棍棒带起呼呼风声，直往楚皓身上招呼。楚山河吓得魂飞魄散，尖叫道：“皓儿，快跑！”然而，楚皓却站在原地，不闪不避，嘴角甚至还带着一丝若有若无的笑意。就在那些棍棒即将落到他身上的刹那，楚皓动了！他的身形快如鬼魅，仿佛一道青烟，瞬间从原地消失。“砰！”一个冲在最前面的林家打手只觉得眼前一花，胸口便传来一股无法抗拒的巨力，整个人如同断了线的风筝般倒飞出去，口中鲜血狂喷，撞在院墙上发出一声闷响，滑落在地，生死不知。楚皓的身影再次出现，已经突入人群之中。混沌圣体带来的恐怖肉身力量在这一刻展露无遗！他甚至没有动用多少元力，仅仅是凭借肉身的强度和速度，便在人群中掀起了一片腥风血雨。“咔嚓！”又一个打手的手臂被他随手一折，发出令人牙酸的骨裂声，惨叫着倒地。楚皓的动作干净利落，没有丝毫拖泥带水。他时而一拳轰出，空气中发出一声沉闷的爆响，中者胸骨塌陷；时而一脚踢出，快如闪电，被踢中的打手往往还在半空，便已昏死过去。那些林家打手平日里在青阳城也算得上是好勇斗狠之辈，但在淬体境五重巅峰，并且拥有混沌圣体的楚皓面前，简直如同土鸡瓦狗，不堪一击！惨叫声、骨裂声、重物坠地声，此起彼伏。短短不过十几个呼吸的功夫，方才还气势汹汹的十几个林家打手，此刻已经横七竖八地躺了一地，一个个鼻青脸肿，断手断脚，哀嚎不止，再也爬不起来。

整个楚家大院，除了这些人的呻吟，一时间竟落针可闻。楚皓负手而立，站在那群哀嚎的打手中央，衣衫整洁，甚至连呼吸都没有丝毫紊乱，仿佛只是做了一件微不足道的小事。这一幕，彻底震慑了在场的所有人。楚山河张大了嘴巴，呆呆地看着自己的儿子，大脑一片空白。这……这还是他那个不成器的废物儿子吗？那些原本瑟瑟发抖的楚家下人，此刻看向楚皓的眼神，已经从最初的担忧，变成了深深的敬畏与狂热。而林啸天，这位林家家主，此刻脸上的表情更是精彩至极。他脸上的肌肉在不受控制地抽搐，双眼瞪得如同铜铃，死死地盯着楚皓，那眼神中充满了骇然与不可置信。怎么可能？！这些打手虽然不是林家的顶尖战力，但个个也都有淬体境四五重的修为，联手之下，就算是淬体境七八重的高手也得暂避锋芒。可楚皓这个小畜生，这个传闻中连淬体境四重都未突破的废物，竟然……竟然如此轻描淡写地就将他们全部解决了？而且看他的样子，似乎还游刃有余！这还是那个被他儿子打得毫无还手之力的楚皓吗？他身旁的林云，更是吓得面无人色，嘴唇哆嗦着，连一句完整的话都说不出来，看向楚皓的眼神，只剩下无边的恐惧。他终于明白，那日在大厅，楚皓废掉他，根本就不是侥幸！楚皓没有理会那些躺在地上哀嚎的喽啰，他缓缓抬起眼皮，目光如同两道利剑，直刺林啸天：“现在，该你了。”他一步一步，不疾不徐地朝着林啸天走去。每一步踏出，都仿佛踩在林啸天的心脏上，让他感到一股莫名的压力。林啸天喉结滚动了一下，下意识地后退了半步，但旋即反应过来，自己堂堂林家家主，淬体境九重的高手，岂能被一个小辈吓住？他强自镇定，色厉内荏地喝道：“楚皓！你……你别太嚣张！我乃林家家主，你若敢动我一根汗毛，我林家与你楚家不死不休！整个青阳城，也将没有你的立足之地！”“哦？是吗？”楚皓嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度，眼中闪过一丝戏谑，“我倒要看看，你怎么让我没有立足之地。”话音未落，楚皓丹田内的《吞天魔功》悄然运转。一股无形而霸道的吸力，猛地从他掌心散发出来，瞬间笼罩向林啸天！林啸天只觉得周身空气一紧，随即一股难以言喻的恐慌感从心底升起。他骇然发现，自己体内辛辛苦苦修炼而来的元力，竟然像是找到了宣泄口一般，不受控制地开始向外流逝！而那股吸力的源头，正是眼前的楚皓！“这……这是什么妖法？！”林啸天脸色骤变，眼中充满了惊骇与不解，他能清晰感觉到自己的力量正在被对方诡异地抽取！这种感觉，他从未体验过，也从未听说过！他拼命地想要抵抗，想要稳固体内的元力，但那股吸力却越来越强，如同一个无底的漩涡，要将他彻底吞噬！“我的元力……我的元力在流失！”林啸天惊恐地叫出声，声音中带着一丝颤抖。短短片刻，他便感觉自己体内的元力至少流失了一成！照这个速度下去，用不了多久，他就会被吸成人干！恐惧，如同潮水般将他淹没。他看着楚皓那张带着淡淡笑意的年轻脸庞，却仿佛看到了世间最可怕的恶魔。“魔……魔功！你练的是魔功！”林啸天像是想到了什么极为恐怖的事情，失声尖叫起来，声音中充满了绝望与难以置信。林啸天脸色唰地一下变得惨白，声音因极度的恐惧而尖锐扭曲，“楚皓！你……你竟敢修炼此等魔功！”他想挣扎，想后退，但那股吸力如同跗骨之蛆，死死地将他锁定。他能清晰地感觉到，自己的力量，自己的生机，正在被眼前的少年疯狂抽取！楚皓嘴角噙着一抹冰冷的笑意，眼神幽深得如同万年寒潭：“成王败寇，弱肉强食，本就是这世间的至理。林家主，死到临头，就别这么多废话了。”话音未落，他丹田内的《吞天魔功》骤然加速运转，掌心的吸力陡然增强数倍！“啊——！”林啸天发出一声凄厉至极的惨嚎，他那魁梧的身躯以肉眼可见的速度干瘪下去，皮肤迅速失去光泽，变得如同老树皮一般枯槁。他眼中充满了无尽的悔恨与绝望，他想不明白，为何短短几日，这个曾经被他视为蝼蚁的废物，会变成如此可怕的恶魔！他淬体境九重的浑厚元力，在《吞天魔功》面前，竟没有丝毫反抗之力，源源不断地被楚皓吸入体内，化作最精纯的能量。不……不要……皓……楚少侠，饶命……我林家……林家愿奉上所有……”林啸天的声音越来越微弱，充满了哀求，但楚皓神色没有丝毫波动。此刻的楚家大院，静得可怕。楚山河瘫坐在不远处，双手死死地抠着地面，指甲缝里渗出血丝。他看着自己的儿子，看着那诡异而霸道的吞噬场面，心脏像是被一只无形的大手紧紧攥住，几乎要窒息。这真的是他的皓儿吗？这种功法，太过邪异，太过恐怖，闻所未闻！他心中既有一丝儿子变强的欣慰，更多的却是对未来的深深忧虑和恐惧。那些楚家下人，早已吓得魂不附体，一个个面如土色，蜷缩在角落里，连呼吸都刻意放缓，生怕引起那个如魔神般少年的注意。看向楚皓的眼神，充满了极致的敬畏与恐惧。
